iPhone 12 Pro Max Hülle - Sechseck-Design

https://makerworld.com/de/models/501904-iphone-12-pro-max-cover-hexagon-design?from=search#profileId-417064

MODEL: ONLY IPHONE 12PRO MAX

 

Cover to be used only for Iphone 12 PRO MAX
Does not fit all other Iphones
Print it with a soft material such as TPU or PETG

 

Hexagon design allows you to see the colour of the body of your Iphone 12 PRO MAX at its best

 

I printed a copy for a friend in PLA, but it might crack over time…you decide what to use

Clean the plate well before printing....if you have doubts about adhesion use 5mm of brim

 

Please if you print it post the picture and like it.
follow me to help me continue with the projects

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: A1Mini  Pla - 0.16mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.16 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#F72323)
